title: Silence Withdrawal / Revelation Through Removed Sound
observed_structure: a stable sound layer establishes environmental or institutional presence
the layer is removed at a consequential threshold
the absence changes perception before dialogue explains anything
cinematic_affordances: ambient system drops while image continues
room tone disappears after a choice
mechanical pulse ceases one beat before visual recognition
silence leaves one bodily sound exposed
cultural_scope: film-sound formal pattern; no sacred or universal claims assigned to silence
transferable_structure: removing an established sound layer at a threshold reveals a changed relation or hidden condition
non_transferable_surface: signature sound design copied from a specific film or silence treated as mystical by default
